summary.text: Chuck Walen is a Republican member of the North Dakota Senate, representing District 4 (New Town) in the 2025-26 Legislative Assembly. The legislature's biography lists Chuck Walen's service as "Senate since 2025". The member page lists Chuck Walen's committee assignments as including the Finance and Taxation and the State and Local Government standing committees.
